create_MarkerInfo: create a MarkerInfo instance to track a marker pinned to an articulated link in the scene
set_targ_js: set the target joint state for a marker by updating the parent articulated object joint positions
get_targ_js: get the current target joint state value for the marker from the parent articulated object
update_transform: update the marker current transform by composing the link node transformation with the offset position
get_current_position: get the marker current 3D position as a numpy array from its computed transform
